facts.business: Shangar Decor Limited provides decoration services for social, cultural, and MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, Exhibitions) events in India.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on: 1) Lack of balance confirmations, reconciliations, and age-wise analysis for certain Trade Receivables and Trade Payables; 2) Insufficient supporting documents for inventory valuation; 3) Non-disclosure of MSME classification for trade payables; 4) Unconfirmed advances to suppliers; 5) Lack of reliable value/supporting documents for investments; 6) Missing confirmations and loan agreements for loans granted.

key_risks: High competition from organized and unorganized players
Entry of new organized players increasing competition
Lack of balance confirmations for trade receivables and payables
Unconfirmed advances to suppliers and loans granted
Insufficient supporting documentation for inventory valuation and investments
facts.related_party_note: During the year transaction with related parties referred to in sub-section (1) of section 188 of the Companies Act, 2013 annexed herewith in Form AOC-2 as Annexure II
